card.learned_from: Feynman 康奈尔信使讲座（1964）、Beuys《Richtkräfte》黑板（1974–77）、Twombly 的灰底画（1967–71）
card.line: 墨绿板面上粉笔一笔一笔写，板擦擦过的地方留一层粉痕，下一笔写在粉痕上
card.fit: 原理推导、公式、一步步想清楚的长讲解
card.instruments: 钢琴、拨弦低音提琴、轻的邦戈鼓
card.sounds_like: 粉笔是沙沙的颗粒声，板擦是一下闷的拖擦，钢琴在擦掉错的那一刻停一拍

stroke.skip_share: 12% holes, 14% half; up to 28% lighter where fast

motion.erase: felt 230×92 px; a wiped line leaves a 4 px blur of itself at 30% and the felt's streaks, settling from 100% to 40% in 0.7 s
motion.close: the panel slides up H + 44 px in 0.95 s (inOutCubic); the next panel has the same ghosts

study.work: The Character of Physical Law (Messenger Lectures)
study.by: Richard Feynman; Cornell University, filmed by the BBC
Joseph Beuys; 100 blackboards, Nationalgalerie, Hamburger Bahnhof, Berlin
